laws.k: domestic-workers|MX|Federal Labor Law, reform of the chapter on domestic workers (2019)
laws.t: Federal Labor Law, reform of the chapter on domestic workers (2019)
laws.tp: Written contract, 8-hour day, weekly rest and mandatory social security.
laws.s2: Kontrak tertulis, kerja 8 jam sehari, libur mingguan, dan jaminan sosial wajib.

coded.vl: General labor law applies, or a dedicated statute grants its core rights
coded.n: Federal Labor Law chapter on domestic work, reformed 2019.

coded.fn: Written contract in a language understood
coded.vl: Written contract required and provided in a language the worker understands
Statutory minimum wage applies on the same terms as other workers
coded.n: Minimum wage applies; a professional minimum set by the wage commission.

coded.vl: At least monthly payment, documented, with limits on deductions or in-kind pay
coded.n: Payment rules apply; in-kind pay limited.

coded.vl: Normal hours limited as for other workers
At least 24 consecutive hours, not replaceable by pay at the employer's request
coded.n: Day and a half of weekly rest.

coded.vl: Equal to or longer than for other workers
coded.n: Annual leave as for other workers.

coded.fn: Keeping own identity and travel documents
coded.vl: General rule only, not specific to domestic workers or without a penalty
Worker may choose to live out; live-in accommodation must be decent and private
Change allowed only in listed cases or after conditions are met
coded.n: Residence permits linked to an offer.

coded.vl: Courts or labor tribunals on the same terms as other workers, or fee-free
Included in the general social security system, including maternity

coded.fn: Protection from abuse, harassment and violence
coded.vl: General criminal or civil law only
May form and join trade unions

dec.n: Random migration checks on roads (Amparo en revisión 275/2019)
dec.ct: Supreme Court of Justice of Mexico (First Chamber)
dec.pe: Three Indigenous Mexicans were pulled off a bus by immigration officers who assumed they were Guatemalan. The Supreme Court said random migration checks on roads are unconstitutional.
dec.pi: Tiga warga adat Meksiko diturunkan dari bus oleh petugas imigrasi yang mengira mereka warga Guatemala. MA menyatakan pemeriksaan imigrasi acak di jalan inkonstitusional.

dec.n: 36-hour limit in migration stations (Amparo en revisión 388/2022)
dec.ct: Supreme Court of Justice of Mexico (First Chamber)
dec.pe: A man was held for a long time in the migration station in Matamoros. The Supreme Court said nobody may be held in such a station for more than 36 hours.
dec.pi: Seorang pria ditahan lama di stasiun migrasi Matamoros. MA menyatakan tidak seorang pun boleh ditahan di stasiun itu lebih dari 36 jam.
